sections.Profile:
The "Oh Boy" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company on February 7, 1964, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Women, Helicopters, Original Theme, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Steve Kordek
sections.Editions: - Oh Boy: 1,700 made, released 1964-02-01, model number 288
